observations: Both maps expose upload address bits24..2 and voice pointer bits24..1. These register widths do not detect installed or free RAM.
Both maps assign resolution, loop, interpolation and byte order to control bits0..3. Playback enable is bit15.
Rate register has31 significant bits; utility converts frames/sec to floor(rate*2^30/192000). Planner conservatively caps supported rate at192000.
Envelope-enable discrepancy: maps specify bit5, utility defines bit4. Planner never enables envelope modulation.

Maps name loop/end pointers without specifying inclusive/exclusive endpoint semantics or a memory-release fence after stop. Planner emits a software half-open bound; hardware lowering and stop proof remain unimplemented.
scope: Read-only extraction; independently implemented validation, no copied utility routines.
